text:
john: Quick sync: RFC proposes adding a small metadata envelope (rw_meta) to responses. concern from SDK folks: breaking parsers that expect the old flat output. need a short compatibility plan.

elena: tl;dr: opt-in Accept header + tenant opt-in flag + tiny server-side shim that converts envelope -> legacy shape. minimal surface area.

rahul: prefer explicit probe rather than UA sniffing. add POST /v1/capabilities to register client support. cache per-client id.

john: agree on probe. fallback rule: header present OR probe true -> envelope path; else -> legacy. shim does deterministic shape translation only.

brynn: header format suggestion: Accept: application/redwood.v2+json; also allow X-Redwood-Features: envelope=1 for older proxies.

elena: telemetry: emit envelope.accepted / envelope.fallback with tags tenant/model/route. sample 100% for accepted, 5% for fallbacks. include migration.wave tag during rollout.

rahul: runtime notes: shim lives at serializer boundary. translation must preserve token order and numeric types. add metrics: envelope.translate.ms, envelope.delta.bytes.

brynn: ops controls: runtime.flag.envelope = off|opt-in|force. default opt-in. force used only when tenant explicitly migrates.

john: rollout plan: 1) land probe endpoint + flags behind off; 2) implement shim in staging; 3) opt-in internal SDKs (10%); 4) increase to 30/60/100%; 5) flip forced for tenants that pass metrics; 6) announce legacy deprecation 9 months out.

elena: automated rollback triggers: tenant error.rate > 2.5x baseline OR p95 latency +25% OR spike in parsing errors -> flip that tenant to legacy path and page oncall.

rahul: third-party SDKs: publish tiny compatibility snips and a helper that calls probe and sets header. communicate in changelog and vendor outreach.

brynn: docs snippet for quickstart:
```
# capability probe
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"client_id":"my-sdk"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/capabilities
# opt-in via header
curl -H "Accept: application/redwood.v2+json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/envelope-probe -> staging (build 5029). CI: 34/36 tests green. :rocket:

ops-bot: added dashboards: "envelope.fallback_rate" and "envelope.translate_latency" and alert "envelope.rollback_trigger".

elena: testing: add golden outputs for legacy vs envelope and a fuzz test that injects optional rw_meta keys to ensure shim drops unknown fields when converting to legacy.

john: security: ensure rw_meta does not include PII by default. add a checklist in PR template.

rahul: implementation detail: cache probe results for 24h, invalidate on tenant config change. tombstone entries to avoid stale positive.

brynn: keep shim tiny: only shape changes, no enrichment or heuristics. predictable behavior is critical for rollback.

elena: owners: john (spec + rollout), rahul (runtime + probe), brynn (SDK + docs). follow-up sync Thursday 11am to review staging metrics.

john: thanks all.
